name: 51012 · Cherokee, IA
findings: ZIP 51012 (Cherokee) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 51012 (Cherokee) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 51012 (Cherokee) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
